user.title: Connect to dash.
user.description: Enter the URL of your dashdot instance as Home Assistant can reach it on your local network, including any DASHDOT_ROUTING_PATH. Home Assistant fetches the data server-side, so dashdot does not need to be reachable from your browser or the internet.

reconfigure.title: Change dash. connection
reconfigure.description: Update the URL Home Assistant uses to reach dashdot, for example after its IP address changed. Entities and their history are kept.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach dashdot at that URL. Check the address, port and routing path.
error.integrations_disabled: dashdot answered, but its API is disabled. Remove DASHDOT_DISABLE_INTEGRATIONS from the container.

abort.already_configured: This dashdot instance is already configured.

data_description.live_interval: How often Home Assistant polls dashdot to feed the dash. card graphs.
data_description.sensor_interval: How often the sensor entities write a new state (this is what ends up in the recorder database).
